name: manual_cb0365
claim: Before dispatching a new agent onto a task in a repo with concurrent multi-agent activity, grep the codebase for actual callers of the module being built or extended, not just its own file and tests. Well-tested, spec-compliant modules can pile up with zero real integration if the orchestration layer they are meant to feed only exists as pseudocode in a spec doc.
conditions: integration review standalone modules unwired spec compliant but not integrated

decisions.notes: 2026-07-11: reviewed 4 merged Phase 1b security modules (provenance, equivocation, distance_bucket, audit_log) - all individually correct (38+ tests), but only provenance.py had a real caller (witness_quorum.py). The other 3 had zero callers outside their own files. Root cause: StateTransitionManager (the designed integration point per DELIVERABLE-2) only exists as pseudocode, never implemented. Documented in docs/phase-0-specifications/2026-07-11-phase1b-integration-review.md.
